headline: The Vistula Is Drying Up. Drought Has Lasted 10 Years
summary: Water levels on the Vistula are exceptionally low, and further record lows are possible in August and September. The drought has lasted 10 years.
why: The Vistula is Poland's largest river, and low water levels affect navigation, cooling for power plants and industrial water supply.
